messages:
maria (CS): Quick triage - Lexa Labs onboarding hit spikes during scale-up (2 -> 50). Seeing bursts of 429s and a few 401s at SDK init (node v0.8.3). Any immediate mitigation?

jordan (SE): Can you paste a tiny log sample and whether x-rate-limit headers show up?

maria (CS): Log snippet: [14:02:12Z] init preflight start pod-17
[14:02:12Z] http 401 POST /v1/sdk/init {error: "invalid_token"}
[14:02:13Z] http 429 POST /v1/preflight {error: "rate_limited"} x-rate-limit-reset=20

sam (SDK): v0.8.3 is known to fanout preflight+token refresh on parallel starts. Short fixes: upgrade to v0.8.5 (adds splay + coalescing) or set REDWOOD_SDK_PREFLIGHT_STAGGER_MS="200-500" and REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_CONCURRENCY=2. Keep keepAlive enabled.

tina_ops: Also ask them to check host NTP - clock skew gives 401s and triggers retries. And prefer connection reuse to avoid per-connection rate accounting.

ravi (eng-infra): I'll bump their token bucket briefly and add tenant tracing to see distribution. Recommend controlled ramp 5->15->30->50 over 10m.

maria (CS): Sent instructions to Lexa. Update: after upgrade + stagger + NTP fix their error rate dropped dramatically during a follow-up ramp. Leaving monitoring open.
